description: This file declares the AttachedSources class, which manages a collection of media source identifiers and their types within the Rialto client component. It provides methods to add, remove, and retrieve media sources, and uses synchronization primitives to ensure thread safety.

classes.name: AttachedSources
classes.description: A class that manages a thread-safe collection of media source IDs and their associated types.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a media source with a specific ID and type to the collection.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a media source by its ID from the collection.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the media source type associated with a given ID.
